g.text: Energy poverty fell during the Ukraine shock because support kept households out (hatched),
then rose to 6% once payments ended. For the poorest fifth, the result turns on who claimed.
Source: CBS/TNO energy poverty monitor (2023–2025 preliminary); model results. Energietoeslag €1,300 in 2022 and 2023, plus €380 for every household.
